The team arranges and reviews tests. This guide shows expected timing; it does not record completed appointments. National Cancer Control Programme (NCCP) 00706 v3: official regimen
Tests in your plan
Full blood count
WHEN
Before every cycle
Checks cells that fight infection, carry oxygen and help stop bleeding.
Kidney and liver tests
WHEN
Before every cycle
Support safe dosing and detect organ problems.
Thyroid tests
WHEN
Every 3–6 weeks during pembrolizumab; sooner if indicated.
Can detect immune-related hormone changes before or with symptoms.
